# ClearButton props

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | `"Clear"` | Accessible label for the clear button, used as `aria-label`. Takes precedence over `labels`. Deprecated: Use `labels={{ clear: "…" }}`, as on the other components, or `aria-label`. `label` still works, and still takes precedence over `labels`. |
| `labels` | `Partial<ClearButtonLabels>` | — | Replaces the built-in English strings, e.g. to translate them. Keys you leave out keep the default from `DEFAULT_CLEAR_BUTTON_LABELS`. `label` and `aria-label` take precedence, and `aria-labelledby` turns the default off: the button is then named by what it references. |

## Labels

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
